verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never lists which programming languages or package ecosystems Gecko supports (e.g., no mention of JS/Python/Java/Go/etc. or npm/PyPI/Maven coverage); it only describes repo connection methods, PR checks, and finding metadata. Community evidence shows scans of a C project, an IRC bot script, and an MCP server, but this is incidental and not a documented coverage claim, and one report noted Gecko missed an issue Semgrep found in a C project. missing for 10: explicit language/ecosystem coverage documentation, dependency/package-manager support list, independent confirmation of multi-language accuracy.
